budget.attempt_consumed_at: before starting the owned project launcher, including startup/preflight failures
budget.order_reason: PID first within every pair to verify the repaired task before ESTA. Fixed order is not randomized; order bias must be disclosed.

height_task.coordinate: local NED, estimated height = frozen_ground_z - local_position.z; not Gazebo truth or terrain clearance
height_task.ground_freeze: last valid pre-arm warmup local_position; archive timestamp/sample, xyz, heading, ref_alt/ref_timestamp and all available reset counters
height_task.target_source: original navigator -> flight_mode_manager -> trajectory_setpoint; no external trajectory/attitude/rate publisher
height_task.takeoff: unchanged commander takeoff; wait for armed airborne POSCTL after original navigation completion; do not issue current-position Hold

reposition.command: MAV_CMD_DO_REPOSITION via existing local-only MAVLink connection, once
reposition.param4: frozen pre-arm heading in radians, matching this pinned CODEV receiver/navigator raw-field implementation only
reposition.xy: retain valid takeoff triplet lat/lon; must capture and verify unchanged
reposition.require: fresh accepted ACK AND AUTO_LOITER AND navigator target readback; ACK alone does not prove target acceptance
reposition.coordinate_reference_change: abort, no rebasing or resend in this batch

entry.require: armed, AUTO_LOITER, not landed, no ground_contact, valid position/velocity, fixed yaw, healthy diagnostics, confirmed target and unchanged reference/reset counters
entry.hover_start_event: only after entry passes; preserve candidate entry samples; verify the final 3 seconds independently in actual ULog

height_task.excitation_clock: unchanged first valid airborne AUTO_LOITER gate starts existing 12s settle; ready by gate+10s, else abort before gate+12s. Derive gate from diagnostic timestamp_sample and excitation_time, not host receipt time. Never reset/restart excitation while armed.
height_task.landing: unchanged commander mode auto:land; require landed and automatic disarm

additional_log_gates.window: takeoff_command <= timestamp < landed_disarmed, enabled samples; excitation fault also checked throughout the armed interval
additional_log_gates.first_input_rule: decode validity bits using selected p/v/FF channels; NaN-disabled channels are not automatically failures
additional_log_gates.retry_policy: even valid second update rejects this comparison attempt; first failure is not erased by final valid=1
additional_log_gates.readback_evidence: archive command/ACK, pre/post navigator triplet, trajectory and consumed p_sp/v_sp/yaw with timestamps; target/height readiness independently checked from ULog
additional_log_gates.observed_not_claimed: online CLI polling cannot guarantee per-callback abort; any offline mandatory failure stops before the next attempt

metrics.primary: time-weighted X velocity RMSE over complete excitation_time [0,32); consumed v-v_sp, no interpolation
metrics.secondary: Y/Z RMSE and IAE in same 32s; position XYZ/yaw RMSE and height in 60s observation; constraints, applied/ideal nu, thrust and actual-update acceleration TV
metrics.pair_rules: inherit protocol01 pair_gate numerical limits unchanged; each same-seed pair must pass before next pair
metrics.missing: retain attempted failure; no replacement, zero fill or imputed pair; no V04 pass unless all six accepted and all three pairs pass
metrics.historical: old V00/V03/V04 runs are descriptive only, never paired with this batch
metrics.interpretation: development admission only; n=3 paired seeds cannot establish general superiority

implementation_gate.runner: new isolated run_v04_protocol02.py, not yet implemented; must not call old takeoff-to-Hold sequence unchanged
implementation_gate.analyzer: new isolated analyze_v04_protocol02.py, not yet implemented; preserve historical analyzers
tests_required: event ordering and full excitation inside observation
first failure and valid/invalid retry rejection, missing fields
stop-on-failure and exactly six single-use attempts
source/model/plugin/firmware checks and exact EEPROM restore
full repaired C++/Python regressions and no-flight SITL/Gazebo build
implementation_gate.before_first_launch: user authorization + implemented/tested runner/analyzer + explicit source commit + clean rebuild and full SHA manifest + fresh seed-use audit; otherwise no launch
implementation_gate.need_new_approval_if: gains, thresholds, task windows, seeds/order/budget or production control/Takeoff/nav/estimator/model logic needs another change

artifacts.source: one clean execution commit for all six; design freeze commit is not yet an execution-ready source assertion
artifacts.hashes: source, binary, assets/plugins, expanded protocol, actual parameters, full raw ULog and all failed attempts
